title: NetBlocks and Kentik: Iran further restricted what little internet connectivity remained, in a bid to curb VPNs, ahead of the Festival of Fire tied to protests (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: NetBlocks and Kentik: Iran further restricted what little internet connectivity remained, in a bid to curb VPNs, ahead of the Festival of Fire tied to protests — Iran's internet, which has been heavily throttled by the regime since the outbreak of war, has gone even darker over the past 48 hours …
